purpose: Teach: 陽子/高山/高松/佐賀/島根/日本橋/水田/淵

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「陽子先生に礼儀を学べ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying you should learn some manners from Youko-sensei.
lines.style: Warm, gently teasing. Lean forward slightly, eyes soft with affection. Steady pace, no rush. The tone of an older sister sharing what she overheard, not scolding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと飛騨高山の古い町並みを観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched the old town streets in Hida Takayama together!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy from the start. Quick, unselfconscious excitement. Lean in toward her, eyes wide. The natural burst of a child who has something to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「高松のオリーブ畑を見に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned wanting to go see the olive fields in Takamatsu.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Slight pause before delivering the information, as if remembering. Soft and wondering. Not quite wistful, but noticing something meaningful in what his father said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと佐賀バルーンフェスタの動画を観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched videos of the Saga Balloon Festival!
lines.style: Unguarded joy. Words tumble out naturally. Voice rises slightly at the end, seeking her confirmation of how cool this was. That genuine, unselfconscious delight of a younger sibling sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「島根の石見銀山を学ぼう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he wants to learn about Iwami Ginzan—the silver mine in Shimane.
lines.style: Quiet reverence in the delivery. Slower pace. She's processing something genuine in his father's words. Slight lift on 「beautiful」-adjacent moments. The tone of someone noticing a pattern.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと東京の日本橋の歴史本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a history book about Nihonbashi in Tokyo together!
lines.style: Sustained excitement with steadiness underneath. Voice clear and present. Not breathless, but genuinely pleased. The comfort of having done something special, wanting to report it faithfully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「水田の四季は美しい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how beautiful the four seasons of the rice paddies are.
lines.style: Softer delivery this time. Almost reverent. Slight trailing-off at the end, as if she's moved by what he said. Warm and a little wondering. The voice of someone glimpsing a simple truth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと川の淵の生物を観察したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I observed all the creatures living in the river shallows—it was amazing!
lines.style: Peak of joy and completion. Slightly breathless at the threshold of the story's end. Clear, direct eye contact in the voice. The natural close of someone who has saved the best detail for last and wants her to really see it.
